title: Controlled LLM-based Reasoning for Clinical Trial Retrieval

live_model.evidence: Abstract: "evaluated on TREC 2022 Clinical Trials, achieving results superior to SOTA: NDCG@10 of 0.693 and Precision@10 of 0.73".

prompt.note: Procedure is described stage by stage (entity extraction, deontic eligibility classification, re-ranking prompts) but no literal prompt template or Appendix listing was found.

claim.metric: NDCG@10, ovC method vs. TREC 2022 SOTA/Median
claim.location: Abstract; Sec. 5 (Table 2, TREC 2022 Clinical Trials Track results)

data.source: TREC 2022 Clinical Trials Track (375,581 CTRs from ClinicalTrials.gov), official public benchmark

notes: Multi-stage pipeline (initial retrieval, deontic re-ranking over up to 25 candidate trials per topic, diagnosis extraction) means several LLM calls per one of 50 TREC topics; est_calls/tier are approximate given the missing exact prompt text and per-topic call count.
